task.description: WF-04, step 1b, gate pass 2 of 3 — CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR checks the reworked interface description docs/design/V1-public-look.md (GUI-DESIGN-ANALYST, rework step 03c of this run, which closed the findings F1–F12 of gate pass 1, handoffs/M1SITE-20261119-01/step-03b-code-design-validator.json; sha256 2e3e2dbd… at the start, 1383 lines) against the approved v3 sample docs/design/samples/picker-v3-approved-2026-10-26/ (README.md, index.html, styles.css, app.js, office.js, data.js and every snapshot in shots/), the quality bar, the WF-04 step 1b rules of the role file, the program files (docs/program/public-v1/PLAN.md M1 with «Owner sees», the requirements and task M1.4; §4.1 the PUBLIC LOOK lane row; gate rows G8, G9, G21, G22; ARCHITECTURE.md §2, §2.1, §2.2, §11.4, §11.6, §11.7, §14, §17, §18, §19), decisions 0065, 0074 (item 6, the word ban), 0080, 0083, 0084, 0097, 0099, 0116, 0118, 0122, and the blocks REQ-111 and REQ-112 as they stand in docs/requirements.yaml (reworked in step 01b; their gate 02b has not run). The text is read in the tree, not the author's summary; every fact it states that the gate builds on is re-checked with the validator's own commands; the sample files and snapshots are opened by the validator. In particular: a side-by-side comparison with the snapshots and styles.css (the owner wants the approved mockup matched one to one, no blended redesign); every page (landing with the stage scene, how it works, examples, the demo survey and its result, 404) at 1470×784, 390×844 and 320×568 in both themes is described; the contrast ratios are computed correctly (at least six recomputed); the not-carried-over list of ARCH §11.7 is complete with the sample places; nothing needs an inline style= or innerHTML; the four desk names «Принято», «Готовим документацию», «Готовим спецификацию», «Готово к просмотру» and the caption «Картинка показывает этапы работы, а не движения людей.» are exact. PASS only when no finding of severity high or medium remains; every finding has its place, the problem with evidence and a concrete fix; Low findings may stand with a PASS when they change no outcome, and say where they go. The owner's words for this run, verbatim: 2026-11-17 (decisions/0115) «Продолжи работу, так чтобы я получил готовый продукт» and «Публичный сайт V1 (Recommended)»; 2026-11-17 (PROGRESS.md, gate row «M1.1 narrowing») «Сначала каркас (Recommended)»; 2026-10-28 (G18) «Да, новые по-английски (Рекомендую)»; 2026-11-19 (docs/owner-requests/2026-10-27-public-launch-plan.md, the appended section) «пуш, брат. Я хочу чтобы ты меня понял в корне и дал мне результат. Исходя нашей переписки и в целом» and «Да, сайт по ссылке (Recommended)» with its option text. Owner gates in force: G8 not asked (default «б»: the order-related landing texts are built and checked locally only, no prices, sales or ads, noindex, the test-mode banner); G9 not asked (kk hidden on production); G21 (a look release reaches production only after the owner's «похоже» on the page itself); decision 0083 item 7 (public pages never show agent events); nothing a visitor types or taps is stored («Без ... данных»). Next free numbers: decision 0123, AP-164, ISS-0124 (REQ-111 and REQ-112 are now taken). The tools check has two expected red tests (CI-3 and CI-8 of tools/test/repo.test.js, open run ISS-0092-20261117-01); they are not fixed here. Read only: the validator changes no file of the project but this handoff (status, completed_at, result); work only inside the Sai folder and the session scratch folder; no git checkout, reset, stash, clean, commit, push or tag, in the project or in any copy. summary: Verdict FAIL: one High and two Medium findings block (G1–G3); six Low findings (G4–G9) do not block. The rework 03c closed all twelve findings of gate pass 1 as they were written (each re-checked below, most by my own runs). What fails now: the class of F1 is still open in places its rework did not list — text, rules and controls inside the cream --rc areas take page-token colours and fall to 1.16–1.96:1 in dark (G1, AP-014); and the description and the requirement blocks reworked in parallel at step 01b disagree in two places — the list «Чего Sai пока не делает» on every demo result (G2) and the canvas palette of REQ-112 criterion 4 (G3).

Item 1 of WF-04 step 1b (sample side): I read the sample's code myself (styles.css all 352 lines, office.js all 542, app.js all 416, data.js palettes, staff, questions and texts, index.html, README) and viewed all 8 snapshots. The inventory S1–S69 covers every visible part I found (shell, start, question, result, «Мой запрос», board; in the scene the door and sign, windows, pin board, binders, blueprint, certificate, the wall clock — the framed picture with hands between desks 2 and 3 in the shots —, plant, desks, people, monitors, lamps, mugs, bell, red box, printer, props, bubbles, couriers, stamp, light, «Вы», plates, camera); each is C, CC with the change named, or N with a reason. Side by side with styles.css: every value of 6.4 (typography) and 6.5 (spacing) equals the line it cites; 7.11's phone bar equals styles.css:311-320; 7.20 equals :22-23; 9.7 equals :56-66 and office.js:397-400. Two Low points on «one to one»: the default of 7.7 is the larger change of the team row (G9), and section 17, the owner's list, misses several visible differences that sections 3 and 8 name (G8).

Item 2 (requirement side): I read REQ-111 and REQ-112 as they stand in the tree (reworked at step 01b, 12:22–12:35Z, during this description's rework 12:19–12:51Z; their gate 02b has not run; §14 of the description says it maps the step-01 text). Covered: the pages and head lines (F3: the landing eyebrow and title hold «Sai — закрытое тестирование»), the examples lists (F4), the test-mode line and the AI disclosure, themes and contrast (with G1's gap), targets of 44×44 (F2), the scene (REQ-112 c4–c9), the reading of c6 as «the stage fits the width», which is now c6's own text. Not covered or contradicted: REQ-111's heading and ten items «Чего Sai пока не делает» on every result and on the no-match result (G2, Medium); REQ-112 c4's page tokens --btn, --onbtn, --acc2 that this canvas never reads (G3, Medium); REQ-111 c1's root-relative href against 7.8's `how.html#stage-n` (G4, Low).

Item 3 (states): §11 and 8.4 describe no script, another language, a storage that throws, loading, server error, no connection, refused, result failure, reload, no match, close options, a lot of data, production and dark. Gaps: the colours of the loading and failure messages when they stand in the receipt (G1); the scene's state while the questionnaire loads and on its error, a state change with no walk, and a walk shorter than the camera's ease (G5, Low).

Item 4 (values named): colours, fonts, margins and sizes are named for every part except the places of G1 (the phone sheet's rows, the example card's lists, the message block on --rc, «<close>»), G2 (the new list) and G5 (frames and camera on a change with no walk).

Item 5 (R2 and the bar; no code): no part of a public page comes from agent events (sections 1, 2, 9.9, 9.10, 9.13; decision 0083 item 7, decision 0097 item 1); nothing in the scene moves or changes by time; the browser keeps only sai-lang and sai-theme («Без … данных»; the description's I3); G8 «б» (section 1 table), G9 (7.2, 13.2) and G21 (section 17, D-list) are kept; no fixed ru word of 13.1 is a form of the lists Г, Б, В, П, Ц, С of REQ-111 or of the word ban of decision 0074 item 6 (read against the lists); the description holds no code.

Closures of gate pass 1, checked on the text and by my own runs: F1 closed for the five named controls (--ring-rc #ce6a1d / #9a4306 = 3.56 / 6.39 against --rc and 3.59 / 5.52 against the --ink frame, recomputed) and for the step boundary (6.39 / 7.77; the bar 1.85 / 2.42 stated as decoration) — the class stays open on --rc (G1); F2 closed (toggle, brand link and skip link at 48; the bar 84.8 = 8 + 18.85 + 2 + 48 + 8, and the sample's own bar measures 76.7 with its 40-px toggle; the 390 fold 725.4 = 665.3 [my run] + 70.6 − 10.5); F3 closed; F4 closed (E2 before E3; 581 and 377.3 px recomputed); F5 closed (my band simulation over every row and column at the three windows gives exactly the 9, 4 and 21 keep values, 29 per theme, the same sets at each window, overlaps from row 6 at 1470 and from row 0 at 390 and 320, and .18 at 1470 dark question 5 row 86 for x 261–269); F6 closed (all 26 derived colours of 6.2 recomputed with the sample's own lines office.js:21-23 run in Node: 26 equal; the colour set of every kept part is complete); F7 closed (the visible-range table recomputed from the formula; my run gives camera 155 at 390 and 190 at 320 on question 5); F8 closed (heights 88 / 76 / 196 recomputed); F9 closed (it produced G3); F10 closed (app.js:43-52, 150, 158, 397 read; the label widths equal my run); F11 closed (292.5; z-order from office.js:424-427; «4 · ГОТОВО К» 110.8 px in my run); F12 closed (the list beside role=img; the «Вы» line in --ink 9.77 / 10.70 recomputed; the dark reference tokens measured equal).

Contrast: every row of 6.3 recomputed with my own WCAG 2.x code (not the author's): all printed values equal (the dark pressed card 8.58 / 5.71 and the dark step bar 2.42 come out so with the rounded hex), and the F1 ring and frame pairs equal. New pairs for G1: on --rc #fffbf0 in dark, --ink 1.16, --ink2 1.91, --acct 1.74, --err 1.96, the list rule (--ink2 35 %) 1.23; in light 12.78, 6.71, 6.39, 7.12.

ARCH §11.7: section 4 has all 14 items, and every sample place it cites is where it says (grep: innerHTML at app.js:86, 98, 175, 202, 261, 312, 328, 333, 355 and office.js:449; outerHTML app.js:240; «Около 2 минут» data.js:12/53/94; «возьмём типовой вариант» data.js:14/55/96; staff names data.js:152-155, 242-245; switchers data.js:38/79/120; WhatsApp numbers data.js:143, 233; wa.me app.js:303, 370; the fit app.js:57, 157, 219, 312, 371).

Inline style and innerHTML: none is needed. Every text is set with textContent (the door sign and the two-line plates by child elements); dynamic geometry uses classes and media queries, canvas attributes, scrollLeft and single CSSOM property writes from a closed list (5.2), which REQ-111 c10 allows (its green twin `el.style.setProperty("--x", v)`) and the CSP allows (handoffs/PAGE057-20261021-01/step-01-gui-design-analyst.json, self_check: a property write worked, setAttribute style refused); the no-script view links a style sheet from a <noscript> in <head>, no <style>.

Facts of the tree re-checked: app/public/index.html has the title and h1 «Sai — закрытое тестирование», robots noindex and the icon data:,; 404.html has h1 «Страница не найдена» and the title «Страница не найдена — Sai»; app/vercel.json ends with the 404 route; docs/design/REQ-108-109-app-skeleton.md N6 (the closed output is index.html = the bytes of gate.html); the step table's source (data.js st 0, 1, 2, 2, 3; tools/src/picker/demo-tenants-v3 desk 1, 2, 3, 3, 4); engine.js lines 163-186 (includes, not_suitable_when). The [T] values of the author's trial page are not reproducible from Sai files (its rules are in the author's scratch); I checked them by arithmetic from my own [M run] values, and they agree.

findings.pass_item: WF-04 1b item 4 and the task's contrast check (ARCH §17 text 4.5:1, accents 3:1; REQ-111 c4 «every pair … the look description lists», c12 «the contrast of every visible text element … at least 4.5:1» in the matrix); the same class as F1 of gate pass 1 (AP-014)
findings.place: 7.18 (lines 692-695), 8.4 state 3 (lines 832-833), §11 row «result request fails» (line 1203), 7.20 (lines 704-711, the closed list at 708-711), 7.16 (lines 683-687), 7.11 the phone sheet (lines 647-649), 7.5 `lnk` (line 544), 6.3 (lines 380-425: no rows for these pairs)
findings.what: The cream --rc (#fffbf0, the same in both themes) holds parts that the description colours with page tokens, which are light in dark. (a) The receipt shows the message block of 7.18 in two states: «<putting your result together…>» (8.4 state 3) and the failure of the result request (§11: «the receipt body shows the same messages; … «<retry>» sends them again»). 7.18 names its colours: title line --ink, second line --ink2, the label «<error>» in --err, the controls «<retry>» (`btn`) and «<to the landing>» (`lnk`, which 7.5 colours --acct). Computed with my own WCAG 2.x code, on #fffbf0 in dark: --ink #f2ead8 1.16:1, --ink2 #a9bcbf 1.91:1, --err #ff9b90 1.96:1, --acct #ffb06b 1.74:1 (as text of «<to the landing>» and as the focus ring of both controls, which 7.20 gives --acct). 7.20 states «No other control stands on --rc: the receipt (7.12) holds none» — false in the failure state. (b) The example card (7.16, on --rc) has «a list» twice «built from … lists 7.14», whose sub-line is --ink2 (1.91:1 in dark) and whose dashed rule is --ink2 35 % (1.23:1 over --rc in dark). (c) The phone sheet (7.11, on --rc) holds «the list of answers (question → chosen option)» with no named font or colour, and its «<close>» is named only `lnk` (--acct by 7.5, 1.74:1 in dark), while 6.1 gives --rclink for «a link or a toggle on --rc»; the sample sets these explicitly (styles.css:323-324). None of these pairs is in 6.3, which the description calls the list the theme-contrast test of REQ-111 c4 reads; REQ-111 c12's browser contrast check in dark would be red, and a developer following 7.18 and 7.14 literally ships illegible text. F1's rework covered the rings of five named controls only (AP-014: the named places were fixed, the class stayed).
findings.needed: For every text, rule and control that stands inside an --rc area — the live strip and the phone bar, the sheet, the receipt in its result, loading and failure states, the example card — name its on-cream value: text --rcink, secondary text --rc2, rules --rcline, links and link buttons --rclink, rings --ring-rc, and an error colour for --rc (for example the light --err #a3261d, 7.12:1 on #fffbf0, in both themes; computed). Say that the message block inside the receipt takes these values instead of 7.18's page tokens; name the sheet rows' fonts and colours and «<close>» as --rclink; name the example card's list colours; add each pair to 6.3 in both themes; correct the closed list of 7.20 (the receipt's «<retry>» and «<to the landing>» in the failure state take --ring-rc). Search every --rc area for the class, not only these places (AP-014).

findings.pass_item: WF-04 1b item 2 — REQ-112 criterion 4 as it stands in the tree (step 01b): «draw.js gets the palette that the look description names for the scene — every colour token of its section 6.2 …, the number --sc-dim-alpha, and the page tokens of its section 9.1 (--btn, --onbtn, --ink, --acc2) — … every marker is found back at least once, itself or in a colour derived from it»

This file gives the canvas only --ink of the page tokens: --btn is not read (F9 keeps the sample's #e0731f), the door and accent 2 are the scene constant #1f7a8c, and --onbtn is never drawn on the canvas (it is the colour of the DOM label «Вы»). The author recorded it as issue I1 (c) of step 03c.
findings.needed: One alignment, routed by ORCH together with REQ-VALIDATOR's gate 02b: either REQ-112 c4's parenthesis is amended to the page tokens this file gives the canvas (only --ink) — then this file needs only §14's c4 row to name that palette — or this file names where the canvas draws --btn, --onbtn and --acc2. findings.place: §10 «Frames» (lines 1164-1166), 9.13 (rows at lines 1077, 1080, 1082; line 1085), 8.4 state 1 (lines 827-828), §11 (line 1200: «the scene at load state»), 9.14 (lines 1093-1095)
findings.what: (a) The fifth answer (or «<enough…>» on question 5) finds «Вы» already at desk 4, so 9.13 starts no walk, yet the light changes from «desk 4 1, others 0» to «others .25»; a result chip of question 5 changes it back and forth. §10 draws frames only during a walk and after a change of theme, language or size, so these lights are never drawn. findings.needed: One rule in §10: a state change by a tap or by the arrival of the questionnaire draws one frame; with no walk the camera goes at once; the camera's ease ends no later than the walk's last frame. Say which state the scene shows while the questionnaire loads and on its error. Cheap in the next rework; else the code design.
